display.purpose: Landing hero and the briefing country headline; Source Serif 4, the only place type gets large (~56px ceiling).

headline.purpose: Serif section headlines that state the finding in plain words; 28px, 32px from sm. Drawer titles use the same voice at a reduced 1.25rem sub-size.

body.purpose: Reading text, short insight copy, controls, primary row lines; cap prose at 65-75ch.

data.purpose: Dense evidence rows and tables, secondary lines, chart ticks, compact controls; tabular-nums for figures.

caption.purpose: Legends, meta, footnotes, AI-provenance notes; sentence case, 12px floor, never a tracked eyebrow.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Info popovers and small floating panels anchored to a trigger.

shadows.name: overlay-deep
shadows.purpose: Larger disclosure menus that must read as a lifted layer over imagery.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color/state transitions on interactive elements.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Standard transition-colors and small affordance transitions (e.g. chevron rotate).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view. Square-cornered UNDP Blue — the one place the system does not round.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--undp-blue, #0468b1); color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--undp-blue-dark, #035293); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--undp-blue, #0468b1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Link Button
components.description: Low-emphasis / disclosure action beside the primary. Underlined text, no fill.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn-quiet">Explore a pilot country<svg class="ds-chevron" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.5 4.5 6 8l3.5-3.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--undp-black, #232e3d); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(35,46,61,0.4); text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: text-decoration-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--undp-blue, #0468b1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chevron { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Small meta/status pill. Rounded-full, hairline border, uppercase muted label. Use sparingly.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--undp-gray, #55606e); background: #fff; }

components.name: Info Badge
components.description: The signature (i) affordance — depth-on-request at the word level. Grey at rest, UNDP Blue when active; opens a bordered explainer popover.
components.css: .ds-info-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; background: #e5e7eb; color: var(--undp-gray, #55606e); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-info-badge:hover { background: rgba(4,104,177,0.1); color: var(--undp-blue, #0468b1); } .ds-info-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--undp-blue, #0468b1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-info-badge[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--undp-blue, #0468b1); color: #fff; }

components.description: Floating disclosure of navigation links. Rounded-lg white panel on the overlay-deep shadow; items highlight on Surface Light.

narrative.overview: The Public Atlas is what a serious public institution would build if it set out to map a country's nature-climate policy terrain and hand it to the people who govern it. It is an atlas first: evidence you can navigate, a landscape of instruments and targets that rewards exploration and guides the eye rather than dumping a table. It is public second: it speaks in the generous, quietly beautiful register of a national broadcaster or a museum wall text, legible to a minister and a junior analyst alike, never a specialist's console. And it is uncluttered throughout: every surface leads with one clear finding and holds its depth in reserve, one click away. The register is calm institutional authority carried by craft, not decoration: serif headlines give the institution a voice, a plain working sans carries the analysis, motion makes a finding land, and colour is rationed so the one blue that means 'act here' still means something.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-led and navigable: the interface maps, it does not lecture.
One finding on the face, depth on request: never a wall of prose or a dense grid at rest.
Serif voice, sans working text: gravity where it speaks, clarity where it works.
Rationed colour: UNDP Blue means 'act' and 'here', nothing else.
Neutral by construction: opportunity for stronger alignment, never fault.
Quietly beautiful: craft is felt, not announced.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: UNDP Blue (#0468b1) appears only on primary actions, links, and current selection; under ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Legible-Axis Rule
rules.body: Red/green is allowed as the intuitive encoding for the alignment axis in data viz (wheel ribbons, share bars, matrices, status dots): green reinforcing, red a possible misalignment worth a second look. Two conditions: colour is never the sole channel (pair with a pattern or text label so it survives colour-blindness), and the no-blame line lives in neutral language, never a whole-surface alert wash or a fault signal. Outside data viz, red stays conventional error status. Supersedes the earlier no-red-for-flagged rule.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: White is the only page ground, landing included; Surface Light marks grouped regions inside it, and on the landing a full-width Surface Light section with a hairline may separate one section from the next. No warm or tinted bands anywhere.

rules.name: The Headline-Is-The-Finding Rule
rules.body: A section headline states the conclusion in plain language, not a topic label. The serif carries the finding; the body elaborates in <=35 words with the rest behind a disclosure.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Voice-Only Rule
rules.body: The serif is for display and headlines only. Buttons, labels, table cells, controls, and data readouts are always the sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A drop shadow means the element genuinely floats (menu, popover, drawer). A resting card with a shadow is wrong; group it with a border or Surface Light.

dos: Do lead every surface with one clear finding in plain words, and hold detail in a drawer, popover, or disclosure.
Do keep UNDP Blue for primary actions, links, and current selection only; under ~10% of any screen.

Do frame flagged pairs and gaps as neutral opportunities for stronger alignment, with an AI-generated + confidence caveat where content is model-derived. Red/green may encode the alignment axis; keep the no-blame line in the words.
Do pair any red/green alignment encoding with a second channel (pattern, dashed vs solid, or a text label) so it reads for colour-blind users; colour is never the only signal.
Do keep the primary CTA square-cornered; round the surfaces and pills around it, not the button.
Do expand every abbreviation on first use or attach an InfoBox; no bare acronyms.
Do keep body text at Ink (#232e3d) or Muted Slate (#55606e); if contrast is even close, move toward Ink.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion; every animation has a static fallback and reveals enhance already-visible content.
Do keep every surface, landing included, on White with Surface Light for grouped regions; no tinted bands.
donts: Don't ship auto-generated consultancy-dashboard output: no extended AI-written narrative, no gradient hero-metric templates, no generative filler.
Don't use alarmist or blame framing: no whole-surface red alert washes, no colour or language that reads as fault. Red/green as a data encoding is fine; a red-alert dashboard is not.

Don't fall into generic SaaS-analytics grammar: no identical card grids, no decorative charts, and no uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section (the SlideFrame per-slide eyebrow is legacy, not a pattern to replicate).
Don't produce dense, jargon-heavy academic output; if a non-technical policymaker can't grasp it at a glance, it belongs behind a disclosure.
Don't let it feel templated or vibe-coded: standard affordances yes, unconsidered defaults no.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored stripe (>1px) on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) or glassmorphism/decorative blur as a default.
Don't put a drop shadow on a resting surface, a serif in a control, or a second competing primary action in one view.
